# Bionics

From RimWorld Wiki

(Redirected from [Bionic](/index.php?title=Bionic&redirect=no "Bionic"))

Jump to navigation Jump to search

[![](/images/9/91/Health_item_bionic.png)](/wiki/File:Health_item_bionic.png)

The icon used for bionic-tier artificial body parts.

For all types of body part replacement, see [artificial body parts](/wiki/Artificial_body_parts "Artificial body parts").

**Bionics** may refer to one of several different [body part](/wiki/Body_parts "Body parts") replacements unlocked by the [Bionic replacement](/wiki/Research#Bionic_replacements "Research") research project. These are: 

  * [Bionic arm](/wiki/Bionic_arm "Bionic arm")
  * [Bionic eye](/wiki/Bionic_eye "Bionic eye")
  * [Bionic ear](/wiki/Bionic_ear "Bionic ear")
  * [Bionic heart](/wiki/Bionic_heart "Bionic heart")
  * [Bionic leg](/wiki/Bionic_leg "Bionic leg")
  * [Bionic spine](/wiki/Bionic_spine "Bionic spine")
  * [Bionic stomach](/wiki/Bionic_stomach "Bionic stomach")
  * [Bionic jaw](/wiki/Bionic_jaw "Bionic jaw")
  * [Bionic tongue](/wiki/Bionic_tongue "Bionic tongue")



They are equal or superior to normal body parts, and provide a bridge between the inferior-to-natural [prosthetics](/wiki/Prosthetics "Prosthetics") and the superior but uncraftable [archotech](/wiki/Archotech "Archotech") parts. Not all body parts are represented in every tier. 

**Bionics** is also used informally to refer to [artificial body parts](/wiki/Artificial_body_parts "Artificial body parts") generally, but is not used as such in-game.
